Both 2D and 3D poses are described; the sampling period is not established here. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT for repository code; dataset licence not verified. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration.
